name: Bluetooth Headphones
author: Homin Luo
description: Call/music mode, call codec (mSBC/CVSD) and playback codec for any connected Bluetooth headphones (built for AirPods); shows whether the kernel mSBC fix is loaded.

barWidget.description: Pops up when headphones connect. Pin the call link, choose mSBC or CVSD, pick the playback codec, and see what is holding the mic.
